name: Orbit Core
description: The settings and the paintings page for the Orbit widgets (orbit_pass, orbit_tonight, orbit_scene): the fal.ai key, the daily painting budget and a contact for CelesTrak and Wikimedia Commons. No widget of its own.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key (AI paintings)
settings.help: With a key the widgets can paint each object once, at about US$0.04 a painting. Leave it blank to use the key under Settings › Generative AI. Without either the widgets show silhouettes.

settings.name: contact
settings.label: Contact for CelesTrak and Wikimedia Commons
settings.help: An email address or a web page, sent in the widget's User-Agent. The widget names its own project page by default.

settings.name: gen_daily_usd
settings.label: Painting budget per day
settings.help: The most the widgets may spend on new paintings in a day, at the models' listed prices. 0 is no limit, within the ceiling under Settings › Generative AI. The visual list is a fixed hundred-odd objects, so a style is painted out in a few weeks and then costs nothing.

settings.name: gen_per_refresh
settings.label: New paintings started per preview
settings.help: How many new paintings one settled preview in the editor may start (1 to 50).

settings.name: gen_parallel
settings.label: Paintings made at once
settings.help: How many paintings fal.ai works on side by side (1 to 8).
